audience: online store owners who collect store and product reviews with REVIEWS.io

useCases.title: Read the newest reviews and product questions
useCases.text: The AI reads company, product and third-party reviews and product questions in one timeline, filtered by type, SKU or tag. It sums up what customers say.

useCases.title: Check average ratings of the store and of products
useCases.text: The AI reads the average rating and review count for the store and, by SKU, for one or more products. You can compare products.

useCases.title: Collect good review quotes and customer photos
useCases.text: The AI reads short highlight snippets (nuggets) by SKU, tag or minimum rating, and customer photos and videos. Use them for marketing.

useCases.title: Check survey answers and invitations
useCases.text: The AI lists surveys and the responses to one, and lists review invitations that are queued or sent, by SKU or order.

useCases.title: Tag reviews or stop invitation emails for a customer
useCases.text: The AI adds a tag to a company or product review, or unsubscribes an e-mail address from invitation e-mails. Nothing is sent to the customer.
